ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 9:1 ratio of high-intensity white pixels (central) to low-intensity black pixels (periphery and localized spots).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous black perimeter banding along the trailing edge and lateral margins; dendritic/branching black clusters at the upper-left distal region; discrete circular black spots located in the lower-right quadrant; isolated 45-degree linear black segment on the left lobe field.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped vertex with an internal angle of approximately 72 degrees; vertex depth estimated at 15% of the visible vertical lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular saw-tooth profile with varying pixel amplitude; multiple micro-serrations (peaks) across both lobes; significant indentation (valley) at the 60% mark of the left trailing edge; jagged topography concentrated at the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature from the median notch to mid-lobe, transitioning to a distal recurve toward the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-intensity white/yellowish three-dimensional clusters (barnacles) localized on the far left and far right distal tips; multiple dark-ringed circular focal points distributed across the right lobe surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct dark linear pixel disruption (approx. 30px in length) at mid-left lobe; secondary series of shorter, parallel dark rake-marks on the right lobe adjacent to the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized epibiotic colonization (barnacles) on lateral extremities; mechanical notches and irregular missing segments along the left trailing edge boundary.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly specific dendritic pigmentation pattern at the upper-left margin that breaks into a fine network of black lines against the white field.
